comment: Dr. Trapp is probably one of the least helpful math teachers I've ever had. I taught myself through the book all semester. She speeds through notes in class to cover content, but never really takes the time to make sure the class is understanding it. Would not recommend her at all.

One of the nicest and smartest professors here, but not easy. Does not explain much in class. Tests are about 1000x harder than any examples in the book or class and are always curved. If you were good at calc in HS you can get an A/B, if it is your first calc class, get a different teacher.

Dr. Trapp is a good professor. She really loves math and really wants her students to do well and love math too. She gives group projects, which can be a pain, but also break up the monotony that can sometimes accompany math classes. If you don't expect to just "get it" and are willing to put in a little bit of work you will do fine in her class.
Takes a lot of points off if you don't show work

Dr Trapp is definitely one of the best professor's I've had at UR. She can sometimes be a little hard to understand; she is very good at Math, but she's not that great at transmitting that knowledge to the students. However, she is REALLY helpful if you attend her office hours.If you are willing to read the book on your own, I very much recommend t
Trapp is tough. She doesn't teach the material well, although she understands it well. She tries not to make tests too hard, but it is still tough to get a good grade
Can't answer questions she gives the class, tests are COMPLETELY unreasonable, not even helpful if you go to her office
She's terrible, she doesn't explain anything, she just expects you to read 30 pages in the book and understand, and she gives tests even when nobody understands... I high suggest against taking her.

I love math...Too bad she is possibly the worst teacher that I have ever had. I always pick things up quickly yetI cant even understand her class She is terrible and if you actually want to understand what you are going, DO NOT TAKE HER. honestly, i highly advise against it because even when you ask questions, she doesnt know how to answer them...

I think she is pretty unorganized!You do not need to go to class- a waste of my precious time!She is never clear and never solves the really tough problems but at the same time there are surprises on exams!I wish there was somebody else to take the class with!Unhelpful as a whole!
Nice but not too good at teaching. If you haven't had Calc before she won't make sure you can catch up.
Dr. Trapp's a great prof all around.  Very helpful in and out of class; the first math class I've ever had where I got more from the lectures than the book.

yeeeeeah, the final was evil, the homework policy was alright after she figured things out.  She's new and you can tell, but she'll be good eventually.  My advice: study for everything you think you don't need to know and READ THE BOOK.  you won't get an arc to the class if you don't.
